text:
About 82% of Americans lived in urban areas in 2017, based on World Bank and UN estimates, and the Census Bureau's 2010 figure of 80.7% under its own definition puts the value in the low 80s. The team note saying more than nine in ten is not supported by these sources, so I'd disregard it. Exact figures depend on the source and how "urban" is defined.

CONFIDENCE: 85
